digest.component_or_area: bridge pause/resume surface and gate format migration
propositions: Pause/resume surface must be rollback-safe and preserve dual-format gate blob with gated_mode:reconcile-check plus paused/reason/who/paused_at metadata
New pause must block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation, return rc 0 with exact anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker, and skip workflow commit-and-push only on that marker

Pause operations must enforce idempotency on same-reason re-pause, refuse different-reason/blank-reason/missing-identity/missing-remote/CAS-conflict cases without overwrite, and use repository git user.email and first-pause RFC3339 provenance

Corrupt gate state must return clean rc 1 recovery line without traceback and be safely repaired by resume without decoding; existing legacy gate rc 4 and pre-gate reconcile-check behavior remain functional
Old reconcile vocabulary, pre-change blob readers, workflow/environment behavior, and legacy reconcile-check early return must remain operational and covered by tests
